features.name: Appel des profondeurs
features.desc: Dépensez 2 Peurs pour invoquer 1d4 Marmes maudits, qui apparaissent à portée éloignée et se placent immédiatement sous les projecteurs.

features.name: Contamination muqueuse
features.desc: Effectuez un jet d'attaque contre un PJ à portée très proche. En cas de succès, le Profond des Profondeurs utilise ses tentacules pour immobiliser la cible, la recouvrant de boue toxique. La cible est Entravée jusqu'à ce qu'elle brise ses liens ou s'échappe avec un jet de Force ou d'Agilité réussi. Chaque fois que le Profond des Profondeurs est placé sous les projecteurs, tous les PJs Entravés de cette manière subissent 3d8 dégâts physiques directs. Le Profond des Profondeurs libère toutes les créatures qu'il a Entravées lorsqu'il est vaincu ou subit des dégâts graves.

motives: Consomme, nourris la cupidité, sème la discorde
desc: Une monstruosité royale et capoteuse avec des cornes circulaires ornées de trésors.

features.name: L'argent parle
features.desc: Les attaques contre le Démon sont effectuées avec désavantage à moins que l'attaquant ne dépense une poignée d'or. Ce Démon commence avec un nombre de poignées égal au nombre de PJs. Quand une cible marque des PV de l'attaque standard du Démon, elle peut dépenser une poignée d'or au lieu de marquer des PV (1 poignée par PV). Ajoutez une poignée d'or au Démon pour chaque poignée d'or dépensée par les PJs sur cette feature.

features.name: Les Nombres Doivent Monter
features.desc: Ajoutez un bonus aux jets d'attaque du Démon égal au nombre de poignées d'or qu'il possède.

features.name: L'Argent, C'est Le Temps
features.desc: Dépensez 3 poignées d'or (ou une Peur) pour placer sous les projecteurs 1d4+1 alliés.

motives: Rejoins les succès des autres, prends ce qui t'appartient
desc: Une créature capricieuse aux membres filiformes et aux désirs insatiables.

features.name: Esprit Non Protégé
features.desc: L'attaque standard du Démon inflige des dégâts directs.

features.name: C'est Mon Tour
features.desc: Quand le Démon marque des PV par une attaque, dépensez un nombre de Peur égal aux PV marqués par le Démon pour que l'attaquant marque le même nombre de PV.

features.name: Rivalité
features.desc: Quand une créature à portée proche subit des dégâts d'un adversaire différent, vous pouvez marquer un Stress pour ajouter un d4 au jet de dégâts.

features.name: Ce Qui Est À Toi Est À Moi
features.desc: Quand un PJ subit des dégâts graves à très proche portée du Démon, vous pouvez dépenser une Peur pour que la cible effectue un jet de réaction d'Agilité. En cas d'échec, le Démon saisit un objet ou consommable de son choix dans l'inventaire de la cible.

motives: Nourris la colère, impressionne les rivaux, sème le chaos
desc: Un démon massif aux poings de taille de rocher, animé par une rage incommensurable.

features.name: Colère Inlassable
features.desc: Les attaques du Démon infligent des dégâts directs.

features.name: Fureur De Combat
features.desc: Dépensez une Peur pour faire bouillir le sang de tous les PJ à portée éloignée. Ils utilisent un d20 comme dé de Peur jusqu'à la fin de la scène.

features.name: Rétaliation
features.desc: Quand le Démon subit des dégâts d'une attaque à portée proche, vous pouvez marquer un Stress pour effectuer une attaque standard contre l'attaquant.

features.name: Sang et Âmes
features.desc: Compte à rebours (Boucle 6). Activez la première fois qu'une attaque est effectuée à portée de vue du Démon. Il décompte quand un PJ effectue une action violente. Quand il se déclenche, convoquez 1d4 Démons mineurs, qui apparaissent à portée proche. 134 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Condamne d'un regard, galope sur l'eau, donne un coup de pied
desc: Un spectre monté à cheval tenant sa propre tête tranchée dans une main et maniant un fouet fait à partir d'une colonne vertébrale humaine dans l'autre.

features.name: Spectre
features.desc: Le Dullahan a une résistance aux dégâts physiques. Marquez un Stress pour vous déplacer jusqu'à portée proche à travers des objets solides.

features.name: Monture Spectrale
features.desc: Alors qu'il est monté sur sa monture, le Dullahan peut se déplacer jusqu'à portée éloignée au lieu de portée proche avant d'effectuer une action. Si le Dullahan est désarçonné, sa monture disparaît jusqu'à ce que vous marquiez un Stress pour la convoquer à nouveau. Le Dullahan est Vulnérable quand il n'est pas sur son cheval.

features.name: Fouet d'Os
features.desc: Marquez un Stress pour effectuer une attaque contre une cible à portée de mêlée. En cas de succès, la cible subit 4d4+10 dégâts physiques directs et est Vulnérable jusqu'à ce qu'elle efface un PV.

features.name: Regard de Mort
features.desc: Dépensez une Peur pour choisir un PJ à portée éloignée. La cible doit effectuer un jet de réaction de Présence (19). En cas de succès, elle marque un Stress. En cas d'échec, elle marque un PV et active un Compte à rebours de Destin (4). Il décompte quand le Dullahan est placé sous les projecteurs. Quand il se déclenche, la cible effectue un mouvement de mort. Si le Dullahan est vaincu ou si les PJ font une pause, tous les Compte à rebours de Destin prennent fin.

motives: Explose, consomme, gagne en masse
desc: Une étincélément élémentaire enflammé.

features.name: Sbire (9)
features.desc: L'Élémentaire est vaincu quand il subit n'importe quels dégâts. Pour chaque 9 dégâts qu'un PJ inflige à l'Élémentaire, faites vaincre un Sbire supplémentaire à portée de l'attaque, si celle-ci aurait réussi.

features.name: Attaque de Groupe
features.desc: Dépensez une Peur pour choisir une cible et placer sous les projecteurs toutes les Étincelles Élémentaires à portée proche d'elle. Ces Sbires se déplacent à portée de mêlée de la cible et effectuent un jet d'attack partagé. En cas de succès, ils infligent 5 dégâts physiques chacun. Combinez ces dégâts.

motives: Réclame des trophées, pille et ravage, teste ta valeur
desc: Un géant à la peau bleue dont les cheveux sont gelés et qui porte des trophées de batailles passées.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: War Horn
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until after the next attack against them.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.desc: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+2 physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

features.name: Cleaving Strike
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from the Titan’s standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

features.name: Trophy Hunter
features.desc: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC’s most valuable possession as a trophy.

motives: Acquérir des richesses, faire chuter des navires de commerce, se lover dans
desc: Une tortue de mer monstrueuse qui possède une carapace et un bec d'adamantine.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Piercing Bite
features.desc: When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

features.name: Tail Bash
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra 1d12 physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

features.name: Gigaton Splash
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take 4d8 physical damage, and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Steam Breath
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8 magic damage and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must choose to either mark a Stress or take half damage. 136 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Camoufler, s'approcher furtivement, envelopper, se multiplier
desc: Une montée d'acide translucide et verte, plus haute que la plupart des humains.

features.name: Slow
features.desc: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Acidic Form
features.desc: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Envelop
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze Envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While Enveloped, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all Enveloped targets are freed and the condition is cleared.

features.name: Split
features.desc: When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

motives: Dévorer, régénérer, terrifier
desc: Une bête écailleuse quadrupède dotée de plusieurs tête au long cou, remplies de crocs menaçants.

features.name: Many-Headed Menace
features.desc: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.desc: The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra’s number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Regeneration
features.desc: If the Hydra has any marked HP, spend a Fear to clear a HP and grow two heads.

features.name: Terrifying Chorus
features.desc: All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.

features.name: Magical Weakness
features.desc: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become Dazed until the next roll with Fear. While Dazed, they can’t use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

motives: Mordre, griffer, bondir, harceler, frapper en balayant, fondre sur, tromper
desc: Une légendaire bête qui possède un visage d'humain, un corps de lion, une queue de scorpion et des ailes de dragon.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Riddle Me This
features.desc: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

features.name: Winged
features.desc: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

features.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Locking Jaws
features.desc: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

motives: Contrôler les vassaux, détruire les rivaux, forger un héritage
desc: Le souverain d'une nation, enveloppé des privilèges de la tradition et maniant un pouvoir inégalé dans son domaine.

features.name: Execute Them!
features.desc: Spend a Fear per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.

features.name: Crownsguard
features.desc: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch’s will.

features.name: Casus Belli
features.desc: Long-Term Countdown (8). Spend a Fear to activate after the Monarch’s desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain 1d4 Fear. 138 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Fuir les poursuivants, vivre brillamment, s'élancer à travers les
desc: Un énorme aigle fait de flammes magiques, impossible à tuer, et chassé pour ses plumes curatives.

features.name: Purifying Aura
features.desc: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix’s Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

features.name: Fireseed
features.desc: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range. Resurrection - Evolution: When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

motives: Plonger plus profondément, manger des poissons, nager paisiblement
desc: Un reptile marin de la longueur d'une pirogue, doté d'un long cou et de quatre nageoires.

features.name: Only a Rumor
features.desc: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can’t be located or targeted.

features.name: Wall of Water
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

motives: Se faire passer pour, semer la discorde, inciter à la trahison
desc: Une entité maléfique qui se fait passer pour une figure de confiance.

features.name: Fiendish Nature
features.desc: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can’t be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Impersonate
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they’re in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

features.name: Turn Invisible
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

features.name: Backhanded Guidance
features.desc: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die.

features.name: Exposed! (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

motives: Revendiquer des âmes, confondre et détourner, s'échapper vers
desc: Un humanoïde gigantesque ayant une tête d'insecte et plusieurs ensembles d'yeux rouges brillants.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Fiendish Resistance
features.desc: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can’t be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Demonic Rage
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Hall of Mirrors
features.desc: Mark 2 Stress to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4). When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die’s current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

features.name: Flash Claw
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 3d20 magic damage.

features.name: Mind Games
features.desc: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can mark a Stress to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead. 140 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Se cacher en pleine vue, préserver la forêt, prendre racine
desc: Un arbre ancien robuste et animé.

features.name: Just a Tree
features.desc: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become Hidden, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.

features.name: Seed Barrage
features.desc: Mark a Stress and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take 2d10+5 physical damage.

features.name: Take Root
features.desc: Mark a Stress to Root the Treant in place. The Treant is Restrained while Rooted, and can end this eff ect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

motives: Fondre, préserver la forêt, rouer de coups,
desc: Un jeune arbre sentiant de petite taille.

features.name: Minion (6)
features.desc: The Sapling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sapling, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Treant Saplings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives: Mordre, charmer, tromper, se nourrir, intimider
desc: Un mort-vivant intelligent avec des sanglantes lèvres et un sourire de prédateur.

features.name: Draining Bite
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 5d4 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: Mistform
features.desc: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can spend a Fear to take half damage.

motives: Obscurcir la lune, murmurer, propager des maladies
desc: Un nuage de chauves-sangs suceurs de sang.

features.name: Horde (2d6)
features.desc: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead.

features.name: Blinding Multitude
features.desc: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

features.name: Bloodsuckers
features.desc: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP. 142 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Détruire à tout prix, effacer, protéger
desc: Une construction dorée couverte de poussière avec des membres cubiques et une énorme masse d'arme pour main.

features.name: Kinetic Slam
features.desc: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel’s standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

features.name: Box In
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Very Close range to focus on. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls when they’re within Very Close range of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

features.name: Mana Bolt
features.desc: Spend a Fear to lob explosive magic at a point within Far range. All targets within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8+20 magic damage and are knocked back to Close range. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren’t knocked back.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives: Concentrer le feu, enfermer, marquer, protéger
desc: Une tourelle vivante massive avec une armure renforcée et douze jambes mécaniques actionnées par des pistons.

features.name: Slow Firing
features.desc: When you spotlight the Turret and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

features.name: Mark Target
features.desc: Spend a Fear to Mark a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the Marked target becomes Hidden. While the target is Marked, their Evasion is halved.

features.name: Concentrate Fire
features.desc: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can mark a Stress to add the Turret’s standard attack damage to the damage roll.

features.name: Detonation
features.desc: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

motives: Jeter une longue ombre, attraper et emporter, pivoter
desc: Un dragon bipède qui vole de son nid en montagne pour dévorer le bétail.

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Terrifying Shriek
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn’t gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

features.name: Clutch
features.desc: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the Wyvern Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

motives: Brûler, défendre son repaire, entrer en éruption, voler, déchirer, prendre
desc: Un dragon cramoisi avec quatre puissants membres et des ailes crépitantes.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Intimidating
features.desc: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

features.name: Flame Breath
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Eruption
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You gain a Fear for each PC who fails.

features.name: Blazing Scales
features.desc: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Slash and Burn
features.desc: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage. 144 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Corrompre, pourrir, fuir pour combattre un autre jour,
desc: Un mage en décomposition vêtu de robes sombres et déchirées.

features.name: Dance of Death
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you spend a Fear.

features.name: Beam of Decay
features.desc: Mark 2 Stress to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d20+12 magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark 2 Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Open the Gates of Death
features.desc: Spend a Fear to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Not Today, My Dears
features.desc: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

features.name: Your Life Is Mine
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal 2d10+6 direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then clears a number of Stress or HP equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack.

motives: Aider les autres à voir la Vérité, faire place à Elle,
desc: Un luminaire du Royaume des Mortels qui a donné son esprit à des entités extradimensionnelles en échange de pouvoirs arcaniques.

features.name: Minion (12)
features.desc: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Sacrifice Self
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

motives: Briser les esprits des incrédules, préparer ceci
desc: Un humanoïde sans visage constamment humide, provenant des Royaumes Extérieurs, aux doigts allongés et à la peau translucide sous laquelle l'on peut voir des vers qui se tortillent.

features.name: Psychic Blast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 2d10+5 direct magic damage. Targets who fail take 4d10+10 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

features.name: Cerebral Incursion
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a Vulnerable target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target’s ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

features.name: Telekinetic Grasp
features.desc: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they spend a Hope. 146 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Acquérir des choses rares et précieuses, célébrer
desc: Un géant d'une beauté dévastatrice, à la peau bleue, vêtu des plus fins soieries et couvert de bijoux. Il se plait dans les choses les plus raffinées et réside dans un palais céleste rempli de trésors.

features.name: Lightning Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+14 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a diff erent target within Very Close range of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by 1d10.

features.name: Mist Weaver
features.desc: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within Close range of that point. The Titan is Hidden to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has advantage on attacks against creatures inside it. The fog lasts until the Titan marks HP.

features.name: Nebulous Transformation
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

features.name: Unleash the Menagerie
features.desc: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to summon an equal number of Griffins, which appear at Close range.

features.name: Wind Worker
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Titan blast wind at a target within Close range. The target takes 4d6+8 physical damage and is pushed back to Far range from their current position.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.desc: When you would gain a Fear from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a d6. On an odd result, you don’t gain the Fear. On an even result, you gain 2 Fear instead of 1.

motives: Donner naissance à la destruction, contrôler le champ de bataille, voler,
desc: Un dragon gigantesque à sept têtes dont les écailles de diamant étincelantes brillent de toutes les couleurs de l'arc-en-ciel.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: Mitera can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Diamond Hide
features.desc: Countdown (7). When Mitera first appears, activate the countdown. Mitera gains a bonus to her Difficulty equal to the countdown die’s current value. It ticks down from Mitera’s “Seven-Headed” feature. When the countdown triggers, Mitera becomes Vulnerable and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

features.name: Elemental Breath
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice: 1. Fire. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d4+1 targets within Close range. Targets who take damage must mark an Armor Slot or 2 additional HP. 2. Lightning. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d6 targets within Far range, so long as each target beyond the first is within Close range of the previous target. 3. Acid. Each PC in front of Mitera within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Armor Slots and 2 HP. Targets who succeed must mark an Armor Slot and a HP. 4. Poison. A miasma of toxic swamp gas Sickens all targets within Close range of Mitera. While Sickened, a target has disadvantage on action rolls until they mark 1d4 Stress to clear the condition. 5. Ice. Each target in front of Mitera within Close range takes 4d8+8 magic damage and is Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Additionally, this area freezes over and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll to move through it. 6. Darkness. A cloud of magical shadow fills an area within Close range. Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are Vulnerable and have disadvantage on action rolls that rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera’s “Seven-Headed” feature. 7. Light. A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within Very Far range.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.desc: Spend a Fear to attack all targets within Close range. Targets this attack succeeds against take 2d20+10 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range. Targets who mark HP from this attack become Vulnerable until they clear a HP. Targets this attack failed against must mark a Stress.

features.name: Fearsome
features.desc: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within Far range, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Seven-Headed
features.desc: When Mitera takes damage, roll a d8. Permanently remove the “Elemental Breath” option that corresponds to the result. On a result of 8, or if the corresponding option has already been removed, tick down the Diamond Hide countdown (see “Diamond Hide”). 148 Daggerheart SRD FALLEN WARLORD:

motives: Corrompre, dominer, punir, briser les faibles
desc: Un Dieu Déchu, enveloppé de rage et de ressentiment, portant des millénaires d'expérience brisant les esprits des héros.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Firespite Plate Armor
features.desc: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by 2d10.

features.name: Tormenting Lash
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

features.name: All-Consuming Rage
features.desc: Countdown (Decreasing 8). When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d6+10 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.

features.name: Doombringer
features.desc: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

features.name: I Have Never Known Defeat (Phase Change)
features.nameEn: I Have Never Known Defeat (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them.

motives: Concurrencer les rivaux, conquérir les faibles,
desc: Un goliath obsédé par le combat, crépitant de colère, portant une armure sur mesure et maniant une énorme masse.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Warlord can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Colossus Crafter
features.desc: Countdown (6). When the Warlord enters the scene, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Warlord is spotlighted. When it triggers, summon the Gargantuan War Machine, which appears at the edge of the battlefield and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Release the Hounds
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord summon two Demonic Hound Packs, which appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Spinning Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range and gain a Fear.

features.name: Ground-Breaking
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord crack the earth with a downward swing of their maul and make an attack against a group within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d10+10 direct damage. The area becomes rough terrain, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

motives: Écraser, détruire
desc: Un construct en adamantine de 30 mètres de haut aux yeux en gemmes, alimenté par un creuset de flammes élémentaires sur la poitrine.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Machine can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Awesome Size
features.desc: When the Machine enters the battlefield, each PC must either lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Rocket Punch
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d12+10 direct physical damage and marks 2 Armor Slots without gaining their benefits.

features.name: Ground-Breaking Stomp
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a point within Close range and make an attack roll against all enemies within Close range of that point. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d12 direct physical damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Additionally, the entire area becomes rubble, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

features.name: Supercharged
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Machine is spotlighted for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the Machine is spotlighted. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block as the Machine’s chest crucible flares with magical flame. For each token on this stat block, the Machine gains a +1 bonus to Difficulty and attack rolls, and its standard attack deals an extra 1d12 damage. Remove a token when the Machine takes Severe damage. 150 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Étouffer l'incrédulité, élever la voix
desc: Une multitude céleste de humanoïdes ailés dont le chant suscite des larmes de révérence religieuse.

features.name: Horde (2d10)
features.desc: When the Choir has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d10 magic damage instead.

features.name: Celestial Coda
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 3). The Choir’s divine song builds on itself with each refrain. When the Choir first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC gains a Hope. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block. The Choir gains a bonus to its damage rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block.

features.name: Aural Assault
features.desc: The Choir unleashes its built-up divine energy in a single burst, clearing all tokens from this stat block. Deal 1d12 direct magic damage to each enemy within Close range for each token cleared.

motives: Obéir, déjouer, punir, se jeter en masse
desc: Âmes des fidèles élevées avec des armées divines.

features.name: Minion (13)
features.desc: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.desc: While the Soldier is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives: Corrompre les purs, infecter les faibles, invoquer
desc: Une agglomération boursouflée et putréfiée d'insectes et de limaces qui se sont formées en une seule masse humanoïde montée sur un cheval rongé par les vers.

features.name: Halo of Contagion
features.desc: The Harbinger is Contagious. When a PC within Very Close range of a Contagious creature takes an action, the PC rolls a d6. On a result of 1, the PC becomes Contagious. While Contagious, a PC has disadvantage on action rolls until they spend 3 Hope to clear the condition. Contagious adversaries are unaff ected by the condition.

features.name: Mount
features.desc: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Locust Swarm
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a swarm of locusts at a point within Very Far range. Each PC within Close range of that point must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d10 direct physical damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1–2, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Frog Spawn
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a clutch of diseased frogs inside the mouths of up to three PCs within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 4d12 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1–3, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Plague Bringer
features.desc: Mark any number of Stress up to the number of PCs in the scene. For each Stress you mark, the Harbinger summons 1d4 Contagious Zombie Legions within Far range and immediately spotlights one of them. 152 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Dévorer, écraser, noyer, saisir
desc: Une bête légendaire des mers, plus grande que le plus grand galion, avec des tentacules munis de ventouses et une mâchoire terrifiante.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Many Tentacles
features.desc: While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

features.name: Grapple and Drown
features.desc: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained and Vulnerable in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

features.name: Boiling Blast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+9 physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives: Changer l'environnement, condamner, décourager
desc: Un immortel gigantesque et incarnation du destin, maudit pour ne voir que des issues funestes.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Walls Closing In
features.desc: When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Pronounce Fate
features.desc: Spend a Fear to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take 2d20+4 direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.

features.name: Summon Tormentors
features.desc: Once per day, spend 2 Fear to summon 2d4 Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC’s personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

features.name: Ominous Knowledge
features.desc: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

features.name: Vengeful Fate
features.desc: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

motives: Dévorer l'essence, maudire, prédire la mort
desc: Un grand duc-hibou vengeant qui a une envergure de 4,5 mètres et un visage humain.

features.name: Ill Omen
features.desc: When a PC within Close range makes an action roll, their Fear Die gains a bonus equal to the amount of Fear you have.

features.name: Witch Barrier
features.desc: The Owl Witch has resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Voice Mimicry
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch beckon with the voice of a beloved figure to a creature within earshot. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or move up to Far range toward the Owl Witch.

features.name: Nightmare Stare
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch Aﬄ ict a PC within Far range with waking nightmares unless the target succeeds on a Knowledge Reaction Roll. While Aﬄ icted, the target can’t clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort the Aﬄ icted creature.

features.name: Visions of a Violent End
features.desc: When the Owl Witch is targeted by an attack, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark 1d4 Stress as their mind is flooded with harrowing imagery. 154 Daggerheart SRD

motives: Établir la domination, exiler de la réalité, flotter
desc: L'ange aux quatre visages du Sanctuaire Céleste qui se manifeste dans le Royaume Mortel comme un tétraèdre flottant avec de nombreux yeux et plusieurs ensembles d'ailes métalliques emplumées.

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.desc: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Elemental Archon
features.desc: Mark a Stress to roll a d4. Adonix activates the corresponding eff ect: 1. Fire Beam. Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield. Each target in the beam’s path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take Severe damage. Targets who succeed take Minor damage. 2. Thunderclap. All creatures within Far range must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated. 3. Lightning Bolt. Make an attack against a target within Very Far range, dealing 4d8 magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a diff erent target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run out of targets. 4. Ice Storm. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d4 Stress and become Restrained until they spend a Hope to escape. Alpha to Omega - Evolution: When Adonix is defeated, they resurrect in Omega form with all HP and Stress cleared. Each PC within Very Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or lose a Hope. You gain a Fear for each Hope lost in this way. Adonix gains the following features in this form:

features.name: Forsaken
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a PC and activate a Forsaken Countdown (1d8) for them. It ticks down when Adonix is spotlighted. When it triggers, the PC must mark all their HP. The countdown ends if Adonix takes Severe damage. You can have only one Forsaken Countdown active at a time.

features.name: Armageddon
features.desc: When Adonix is defeated again, they unleash a reality storm that shakes the realms to their foundations. Roll a d6. On a result of 5–6, each PC must make a death move. VOLCANIC DRAGON:

motives: Noyer de lave, incinérer, repousser les Envahisseurs,
desc: Fou de rage à cause de ses blessures, le dragon explose en lave en fusion.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cracked Scales
features.desc: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of d6s equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Shattering Might
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d8+1 physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

features.name: Eruption
features.desc: Spend a Fear to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge’s scales, filling the area within Very Close range with molten lava. All targets in that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+6 physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. This area remains lava. When a creature other than the Molten Scourge enters that area or acts while inside of it, they must mark 6 HP.

features.name: Volcanic Breath
features.desc: When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll a d10. On a result of 8 or higher, the Molten Scourge breathes a flow of lava in front of them within Far range. All targets in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+4 physical damage, mark 1d4 Stress, and are Vulnerable until they clear a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Dig Two Graves
features.desc: When the Knight is defeated, they make an attack against a target within Very Close range (prioritizing the creature who killed them). On a success, the target takes 1d4+8 physical damage and loses 1d4 Hope.

motives: Faire le mort, se rassembler, voler la peau
desc: Un squelette couvert de terre, armé d'une lame rouillée.

features.name: Only Bones
features.desc: The Warrior is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Won’t Stay Dead
features.desc: When the Warrior is defeated, you can spotlight them and roll a d6. On a result of 6, if there are other adversaries on the battlefield, the Warrior re-forms with no marked HP.

motives: Cliquer bruyamment, se déplacer comme une horloge, observer
desc: Une armure complète de plate qui brille d'un faible halo de lumière fantomatique.

features.name: Tireless
features.desc: The Armor can’t be forced to mark Stress. When an eff ect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the eff ect.

features.name: Clatter & Recombobulate
features.desc: Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can spend a Fear to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.

motives: Consommer, obscurcir, se jeter en masse
desc: Une masse de rongeurs ordinaires qui se déplace comme une seule entité, une vague vorace.

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.desc: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: In Your Face
features.desc: All targets within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the Swarm.

motives: Ambush, se cacher, submerger, protéger, suivre
desc: Un guerrier féérique paré d'une armure faite de feuilles et d'écorce.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.desc: If the Soldier makes a standard attack and another Sylvan Soldier is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d8+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Forest Control
features.desc: Spend a Fear to pull down a tree within Close range. A creature hit by the tree must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (15) or take 1d10 physical damage.

features.name: Blend In
features.desc: When the Soldier makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to become Hidden until the Soldier’s next attack or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll (14) to find them.

motives: Se poster, ramper, frapper
desc: Un petit serpent qui empoisonne sa proie avec des crocs charniérés.

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous
features.desc: When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily Envenomated. While Envenomated, the target must mark a Stress whenever they make an action roll.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives: Avancer menaçamment, gémir de douleur
desc: Une construction de cire de dix pieds de haut, semi-solide (et semi-consciente).

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: No Vital Organs
features.desc: The Creation doesn’t take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

features.name: Wax Ball
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 1d12+2 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Splutch!
features.desc: When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, the attacker’s weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Smothering Grapple
features.desc: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to Trap the target inside the Creation’s wax body. While Trapped, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it’s spotlighted. A Trapped creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

motives: Échanger des informations sur les possibles
desc: Une grande créature de type méduse interdimensionnelle qui flotte dans et hors du flux temporel.

features.name: Telepathic
features.desc: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

features.name: Psychic Strongbox
features.desc: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would aff ect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

features.name: Glitch Wave
features.desc: Spend a Fear and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

features.name: Temporal Corrosion
features.desc: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a −2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

motives: Écraser, détruire, grêle de débris, heurter
desc: Un grand cadavre, gonflé par la décomposition et enragé.

features.name: Slow
features.desc: When you spotlight the Zombie and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the Zombie and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Rend Asunder
features.desc: Make a standard attack with advantage against a target the Zombie has Restrained. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Rip and Tear
features.desc: When the Zombies makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.

motives: Dévorer, affamé, attaquer l'ennemi en groupe, déchirer la chair
desc: Un cadavre animé qui se déplace de manière instable, poussé uniquement par la faim.

features.name: Too Many to Handle
features.desc: When the Zombie is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other Zombie is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.

features.name: Horrifying
features.desc: Targets who mark HP from the Zombie’s attacks must also mark a Stress.

motives: Consommer la chair, avoir faim, dévorer
desc: Un groupe de cadavres qui se traînent et se déplacent ensemble par instinct.

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.desc: When the Zombies have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Zombies mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

motives: Guider une embuscade, survivre, tuer, préparer
desc: Un tueur expérimenté avec une voix menaçante et une lame mortelle.

features.name: Won’t See It Coming
features.desc: The Assassin deals direct damage while they’re Hidden.

features.name: Strike as One
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin’s unmarked Stress.

features.name: The Subtle Blade
features.desc: When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a Vulnerable target, you can spend a Fear to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives: Guider une embuscade depuis l'intérieur d'objets solides, effrayer
desc: Un esprit de fée corrompu qui hanter la nuit sous la forme d'un spectre élancé portant une robe de gaze luminescente.

features.name: Specter
features.desc: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Scare Tactic
features.desc: Up to three times per scene, spend a Fear to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks 1d4 Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

features.name: Wail of Despair
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d12+1 magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

motives: Accepter le changement, hurler à la lune, mener
desc: Un commandant vétéran qui avale des élixirs magiques pour se transformer en bête et mener sa meute à la chasse.

features.name: Pack Fury
features.desc: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack’s target.

features.name: Bark at the Moon
features.desc: Once per scene, spend a Fear to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.desc: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

motives: Coordonnez-vous avec les membres de la meute, dansez autour de la
desc: Un guerrier enragé qui absorbe des potions rituelles pour améliorer sa forme avec les aspects d'une bête prédatrice.

features.name: Pack Fury
features.desc: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack’s target.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.desc: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

motives: Vivre en harmonie avec la nature, protéger la
desc: Un gardien mi-humain, mi-cheval qui patrouille les frontières de terres idylliques, corrompues par la touche de la civilisation.

features.name: Flanking Maneuver
features.desc: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden’s allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

features.name: Eye of the Sage
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19–20.

features.name: Trample
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d6+2 physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Quick Volley
features.desc: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can mark any number of Stress to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

motives: Séduire, manœuvrer, sécuriser des mécènes
desc: Un manipulateur accompli et maître des arts sociaux.

features.name: Searing Glance
features.desc: When a PC within Close range makes a Presence Roll, you can mark a Stress to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target’s failure, they must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target’s success, they must mark a Stress.

motives: Se concilier les faveurs, gêner les ennemis, découvrir des connaissances
desc: Un mage expérimenté maniant l'ombre et la peur.

features.name: Enervating Blast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Shroud of the Fallen
features.desc: Mark a Stress to wrap an ally within Close range in a shroud of Protection until the Adept marks their last HP. While Protected, the target has resistance to all damage.

features.name: Shadow Shackles
features.desc: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point are Restrained in smoky chains until they break free with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll. A target Restrained by this feature must spend a Hope to make an action roll.

features.name: Fear Is Fuel
features.desc: Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with Fear, clear a Stress.

motives: Capturer des sacrifices, isoler les proies, s'élever dans
desc: Un tueur devenu un adepte d'un culte.

features.name: Shadow’s Embrace
features.desc: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. Mark a Stress to move from one shadow to another within Far range.

features.name: Pick Off the Straggler
features.desc: Mark a Stress to cause a target within Melee range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within Far range, making them temporarily Vulnerable. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

motives: Ambusher les proies, tuer pour le plaisir, jouer avec la nourriture,
desc: Un canidé magique vicieux aux yeux brillants et doté de deux queues fouettantes épineuses. Il confond ses ennemis en créant un double illusoire de lui-même.

features.name: Blink Beast
features.desc: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate’s. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate’s place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you spend a Fear to conjure it again.

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

motives: Exploiter une ouverture, prendre de la distance, abattre
desc: Un chevalier revêtu d'une armure en plaques de dragon et d'un casque en forme de tête de dragon.

features.name: High Ground
features.desc: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

features.name: Leaping Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra 1d12 damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Comeback
features.desc: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the attack with advantage.

motives: Attaque éclair, déchirer, terrifier
desc: Un grand squelette humanoïde mort-vivant avec le crâne d'une panthère pour tête.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Bloody Strike
features.desc: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Screeching Caterwaul
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become Rattled until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a Rattled PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the Rattled condition from the target.

features.name: I Alone
features.desc: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

features.name: Vicious Reprisal
features.desc: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against that PC.

motives: Formez le bloc, protégez l'impératrice, frappez d'un seul coup
desc: Un soldat mort-elite enterré avec son impératrice pour défendre la tombe des vols et profanations.

features.name: Battle Formation
features.desc: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

features.name: Javelin
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

motives: Recouvrez le sol, dévorez les vivants, rampez
desc: Des coléoptères carnivores qui creusent sous la peau.

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.desc: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Omophagous
features.desc: Mark a HP to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to mark a Stress and Infecting them. While Infected, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

motives: Ne cessez jamais de travailler, sacrifiez-vous pour le
desc: Un malheureux ouvrier mort-vivant choisi par tirage au sort pour murer la tombe de l'impératrice de l'intérieur.

features.name: Minion (5)
features.desc: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: The Work Never Ends
features.desc: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can spend a Fear to clear the Stonemason’s HP and Stress.

motives: Évitez la violence, pulvérisez les attaquants
desc: Une créature de taille d'halfling faite de champignons qui se défend contre les attaquants avec de petites explosions de spores neurotoxiques.

features.name: Minion (6)
features.desc: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Form Up
features.desc: Spend a Fear to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

motives: Réveillez les tombés, défendez la colonie, propagez
desc: Une créature champignonne géante qui peut commander les morts.

features.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become Poisoned until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While Poisoned, a target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reanimator
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.

features.name: Colony
features.desc: Mark any number of Stress to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range.

features.name: Mind Meld
features.desc: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

motives: Gagnez votre vie, submergez, écrasez, renversez
desc: Un génet particulièrement musclé maniant un maillet de guerre plus grand qu'un humain.

features.name: Battering Ram
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Brawler charge at an inanimate object within Close range they could feasibly smash (such as a wall, cart, or market stand) and destroy it. All targets within Very Close range of the object must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d4+3 physical damage from the shrapnel.

features.name: Bloody Reprisal
features.desc: When the Brawler marks 2 or more HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can make a standard attack against the attacker. On a success, the Brawler deals 2d6+15 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Brawler makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives: Chassez les proies, restez mobiles, frappez décisivement
desc: Un oiseau proie géant aux serres tachées de sang.

features.name: Flight
features.desc: While flying, the Eagle gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Deadly Dive
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and knock the target over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

features.name: Take Off
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+3 physical damage and the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or become temporarily Restrained within the Eagle’s massive talons. If the target is Restrained, the Eagle immediately lifts into the air to Very Far range above the battlefield while holding them.

features.name: Deadly Drop
features.desc: While flying, the Eagle can drop a Restrained target they are holding. When dropped, the target is no longer Restrained but starts falling. If their fall isn’t prevented during the PCs’ next action, the target takes 2d20 physical damage when they land.

motives: Ambitionnez les rivaux, cherchez les richesses, lancez des rayons
desc: Une boule flottante de chair remplie de dents, possédant de nombreux yeux et un faisceau de tentacules buccaux explorateurs qui lancent des rayons magiques.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Anti-Mystica-Halitosis
features.desc: The Gobstalker’s rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic eff ect fails automatically if used within Close range of the Gobstalker.

features.name: Tentacle Rays
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, roll a d8 for a random beam attack or spend a Fear to choose instead: 1. Beguile. The Gobstalker Beguiles the target. While Beguiled, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can’t attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with Fear, a Beguiled PC must mark a Stress or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A Beguiled PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) to clear the condition. 2. Corrode. The target takes 2d8 magic damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t, double the damage. 3. Doom. The target must mark all HP, but they can spend any number of Hope to reduce the number of HP marked this way by an equal amount. 4. Hypnosis. The target falls into a Deep Trance and can’t act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful Presence Roll (16). 5. Paralyze. The target freezes in place, becoming Vulnerable and Restrained until they mark 2 Stress. 6. Sear. The target takes 2d8 direct magic damage. 7. Scare. The target is Scared. While Scared, the target can’t take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must mark a Stress whenever you spend a Fear. The target can clear the condition with a successful Presence Roll (16). 8. Slow. The target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress to move until they spend 2 Hope.

features.name: Leech Lick
features.desc: On a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to clear a number of Stress equal to the number of HP the target marked.

motives: Soutenir les alliés, mener la meute, rassembler les troupes
desc: Un seigneur de guerre polymorphe qui mène un groupe de guerriers au combat.

features.name: Pack Alpha
features.desc: Pool. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within Close range makes an attack, you can spend a token from the Guahalan Pool to give them advantage on the roll.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Call of the Guahala
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight all Guahalan Shifters within Close range. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Feral Form (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Fang Lord marks their last HP, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately spotlight them.

motives: S'échapper, profiter, jeter de la fumée
desc: Un guerrier masqué polymorphe aux traits animaliers.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Pack Attack
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within Very Close range of the target.

motives: Manger, faire un désordre, patrouiller dans son territoire
desc: Un géant habillé de peaux animales et entouré d'un essaim d'insectes.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Gullible
features.desc: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

features.name: Bug Swarm
features.desc: PCs are Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

features.name: Mighty Swing
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

motives: Enfermer la proie dans du miel, protéger la ruche
desc: Un cad rempli et manipulé par une colonie d'abeilles charognardes.

features.name: Blood Honey
features.desc: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained as the honey hardens on them.

features.name: Bee-Ruption
features.desc: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 1d8 direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. Restrained targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

motives: Mordre, flotter, rire, raconter des histoires effrayantes
desc: Une citrouille ou autre gourde flottante avec un visage sculpté. L'âme piégée à l'intérieur émet une lueur sinistre.

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Jack-o’-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o’- Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o’-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
features.desc: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to gain an additional Fear.

motives: Creuser, jaillir du sol, tourner autour de la proie
desc: Un requin quadrupède qui nage à travers le sol.

features.name: Burrowing
features.desc: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can’t attack.

features.name: Thick-Skinned
features.desc: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

features.name: Rending Chomp
features.desc: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

motives: Mordre, creuser, jaillir du sol
desc: Un requin terrestre ayant vécu suffisamment longtemps pour devenir une monstruosité fouisseuse de grande taille, avec une peau d'acier et des dents tranchantes.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Deep Diver
features.desc: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can’t attack.

features.name: Steel-Skinned
features.desc: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

features.name: Forceful Eruption
features.desc: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming Vulnerable until they make an action roll. For each PC made Vulnerable in this way, you gain a Fear.

motives: Dévorer, chasser, pister
