desc: Une figure mort-vivante portant un long manteau en cuir, aux yeux scrutateurs et au comportement cruelment nonchalant.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Deathlock
features.desc: Spend a Fear to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic Deathlock until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a Deathlocked target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one Deathlock at a time.

features.name: Inevitable Death
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Rampage
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

motives: Embuscade, guetter, avaler sans mâcher,
desc: Un prédateur polymorphe qui prend l'apparence d'objets inanimés pour attirer des proies imprudentes dans sa portée de menace.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and Restrained until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can spend a Fear to activate the Mockery’s Devour feature against the target.

features.name: Devour
features.desc: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

features.name: Never Just One
features.desc: Spend a Fear to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

motives: Rassemble-toi, griffe et écorche
desc: Une botte de paille liée en forme humanoïde, vêtue de haillons, et animée par une âme piégée.

features.name: Made of Straw
features.desc: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

features.name: Terror Vision
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing 2d8 magic damage and making them Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

motives: Amasser un grand pouvoir, comploter, prendre le commandement
desc: Un leader clandestin avec un canal direct vers les Dieux Chutés.

features.name: Seize Your Moment
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Our Master’s Will
features.desc: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, mark a Stress to gain a Fear.

features.name: Summoning Ritual
features.desc: Countdown (6). When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick down this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.

features.name: Fallen Hounds
features.desc: Once per scene, when the Secret- Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

motives: Trouver le sang, isoler la proie, cibler le faible
desc: Un grand prédateur aquatique, toujours en mouvement.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Shark makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Rending Bite
features.desc: When the Shark makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Blood in the Water
features.desc: When a creature within Close range of the Shark marks HP from another creature’s attack, you can mark a Stress to immediately spotlight the Shark, moving them into Melee range of the target and making a standard attack.

motives: Se déplacer à travers les objets solides, protéger le trésor,
desc: Un combattant spectral avec des lances et des épées, ancré par son devoir.

features.name: Ghost
features.desc: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Grave Blade
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+6 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

motives: Éviter la détection, laisser le poison faire son travail,
desc: Un petit guerrier ailé qui attaque les intrus avec des flèches empoisonnées.

features.name: Minion (5)
features.desc: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Art of Invisibility
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make the Sprite Hidden until they attack.

features.name: Dream Petal Poison
features.desc: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Sleepy until the target takes damage. While Sleepy, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.

motives: Prendre la fuite, déguiser son apparence, espionner
desc: Un agent d'espionnage habile avec un don pour être au bon endroit pour entendre des secrets.

features.name: Gathering Secrets
features.desc: Spend a Fear to describe how the Spy knows a secret about a PC in the scene.

features.name: Fly on the Wall
features.desc: When a PC or group is discussing something sensitive, you can mark a Stress to reveal that the Spy is present in the scene, observing them. If the Spy escapes the scene to report their findings, you gain 1d4 Fear.

motives: Manger des fougères, se déplacer en troupeau pour protection, patrouiller
desc: Un grand dinosaure qui possède une collerette blindée et trois cornes.

features.name: Leathery Hide
features.desc: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can mark any number of Stress instead of an equal number of HP.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 5d6 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal 3d10 direct physical damage.

motives: Percevoir la lisière de la forêt, manger, se déplacer en piétinant
desc: Un dinosaure carnivore géant qui marche sur deux jambes.

features.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
features.desc: Spend a Fear to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Stomp
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 3d12 direct physical damage.

features.name: Crushing Bite
features.desc: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an additional HP.

motives: Développer de nouveaux sorts, rechercher le pouvoir,
desc: Un mage endurci par la bataille, formé à la magie destructrice.

features.name: Battle Teleport
features.desc: Before or after making a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to teleport to a location within Far range.

features.name: Refresh Warding Sphere
features.desc: Mark a Stress to refresh the Wizard’s “Warding Sphere” reaction.

features.name: Eruption
features.desc: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. A Very Close area around that point erupts into impassable terrain. All targets within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take 2d10 physical damage and are thrown out of the area. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren’t moved.

features.name: Arcane Artillery
features.desc: Spend a Fear to unleash a precise hail of magical blasts. All targets in the scene must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Warding Sphere
features.desc: When the Wizard takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal 2d6 magic damage to the attacker. This reaction can’t be used again until the Wizard refreshes it with their “Refresh Warding Sphere” action.

motives: Corrompre, détruire, submerger d'un pouvoir maléfique
desc: Un chercheur de connaissances secrètes caché dans une remplie de livres.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Orbiting Aegis
features.desc: When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a d6 Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

features.name: Force Salvo
features.desc: Spend any number of Fear and roll that many d4s. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

features.name: Fireball
features.desc: Mark any number of Stress to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d10 magic damage.

features.name: Counterspell
features.desc: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can spend a Fear to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll’s result. On a success, the PC’s Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can’t Counterspell a critical success.

motives: Dominer la conversation, attirer l'attention,
desc: Un squelette richement paré qui a un appétit insatiable pour l'or.

features.name: Attracted to Wealth
features.desc: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

features.name: The Weight of Opulence
features.desc: Spend a Fear to turn the Catrin’s gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they’re carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

features.name: Expensive Failure
features.desc: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can mark a Stress to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

motives: Écholocaliser, voler silencieusement, fondre dans les ombres
desc: Une grande créature de papillon aux yeux rouges qui se tient debout et annonce des événements mystérieux ou maléfiques.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Psychic Screech
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suff er visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take 3d8 direct magic damage and become Vulnerable until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Shadow Swarm
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren’t Cryptimoths are Vulnerable while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

features.name: Paranoia Glare
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can’t Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

motives: Séparer les ennemis, frapper depuis l'ombre,
desc: Une créature mi-poisson, mi-humain, liée psychiquement pour servir les Habitants des Profondeurs.

features.name: Fish-Tailed
features.desc: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

features.name: Gang Up
features.desc: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

features.name: “Get Over Here!”
features.desc: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

motives: Rendre la peur contagieuse, rester à l'ombre,
desc: Une créature démoniaque enveloppée d'un manteau, aux longs membres et aux ombres qui suintent.

features.name: Depths of Despair
features.desc: The Demon deals double damage to PCs with 0 Hope.

features.name: Your Struggle Is Pointless
features.desc: Spend a Fear to weigh down the spirits of all PCs within Far range. All targets aff ected replace their Hope Die with a d8 until they roll a success with Hope or their next rest.

features.name: Your Friends Will Fail You
features.desc: When a PC fails with Fear, you can mark a Stress to cause all other PCs within Close range to lose a Hope.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives: Faire le condescendant, déclarer une victoire prématurée
desc: Un démon d'une beauté parfaite et d'une cruauté infinie, tenant une lance étincelante et vêtu de robes élégantes.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Demon makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range must lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.desc: When a PC within Far range fails a roll, they can choose to reroll their Fear Die and take the new result. If they still fail, they mark 2 Stress and the Demon clears a Stress.

features.name: Unparalleled Skill
features.desc: Mark a Stress to deal the Demon’s standard attack damage to a target within Close range.

features.name: The Root of Villainy
features.desc: Spend a Fear to spotlight two other Demons within Far range.

features.name: You Pale in Comparison
features.desc: When a PC fails a roll within Close range of the Demon, they must mark a Stress.

motives: Plonger-bombarde, se cacher, protéger le chef
desc: Un animal à larges ailes, fidèle à son maître vampire sans aucune limite.

features.name: Flying
features.desc: While flying, the Bat gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Screech
features.desc: Mark a Stress to send a high-pitch screech out toward all targets in front of the Bat within Far range. Those targets must mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Guardian
features.desc: When an allied Vampire marks HP, you can mark a Stress to fly into Melee range of the attacker and make an attack with advantage against them. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

motives: Enrouler et écraser, protéger le maître, se faufiler
desc: Un quadrupède griffu possédant un corps écailleux de serpent et une volonté de servir ses cousins, les dragons.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Guard Dog
features.desc: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can mark a Stress to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake’s new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

motives: Commander, cultiver, chasser, préserver le
desc: Un esprit de la nature prenant la forme d'un humanoïde-arbre.

features.name: Bramble Patch
features.desc: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Create a patch of thorns that covers an area within Close range of that point. All targets within that area take 2d6+2 physical damage when they act. A target must succeed on a Finesse Roll or deal more than 20 damage to the Dryad with an attack to leave the area.

features.name: Grow Saplings
features.desc: Spend a Fear to grow three Treant Sapling Minions, who appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: We Are All One
features.desc: When an ally dies within Close range, you can spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress as the fallen ally’s life force is returned to the forest.

motives: Trouver des objets magiques, inspirer la peur, patrouiller dans les cieux
desc: L'ombre d'un souverain oublié, maudit pour patrouiller les cieux au-dessus d'une anguille ailée au service d'un mal encore plus grand.

features.name: Fellmount
features.desc: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he’s knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Light and Shadow
features.desc: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.

features.name: Relic Hunter
features.desc: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

features.name: Hellsong
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Shadow King’s mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope. If a PC can’t lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.

features.name: Air Support
features.desc: Three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with advantage.

motives: Agir vaillamment, faire la guerre, penser tactiquement
desc: Un goliath en armure, à la peau cendrée et aux cheveux de feu, maniant une grande épée d'artisanat maître forgée dans sa propre forge.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Masterwork Armor
features.desc: Countdown (3). When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by 1d12. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Hurl Rock
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take 3d12 physical damage.

features.name: Skull Splitter
features.desc: Mark a Stress to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must spend the token from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal 3d20+5 direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress.

features.name: Blazing Heart
features.desc: When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

motives: Avalanche, renverser, pilonner
desc: Un glissement de terrain vivant de rochers et de poussière, aussi grand qu'une maison.

features.name: Slow
features.desc: When you spotlight the Elemental and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the Elemental and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Crushing Blows
features.desc: When the Elemental makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Immovable Object
features.desc: An attack that would move the Elemental moves them two fewer ranges (for example, Far becomes Very Close). When the Elemental takes physical damage, reduce it by 7.

features.name: Rockslide
features.desc: Mark a Stress to create a rockslide that buries the land in front of Elemental within Close range with rockfall. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (19). Targets who fail take 2d12+5 physical damage and become Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives: Déluge, disperser, noyer
desc: Une vague vivante gigantesque qui s'abat sur les ennemis.

features.name: Water Jet
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+7 physical damage and the target’s next action has disadvantage. On a failure, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Drowning Embrace
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against become Restrained and Vulnerable as they begin drowning. A target can break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll.

features.name: High Tide
features.desc: When the Elemental makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to knock the target back to Close range.

motives: Attaquer l'insoupçonné, éviter la lumière du soleil, sucer la vie
desc: Un monstre humanoïde à queue de serpent qui rôde la nuit pour absorber l'énergie vitale des gens endormis.

features.name: Constriction
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

features.name: Life Leech
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4−1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Sleep Toxin
features.desc: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

motives: Séduire par des connaissances secrètes, tendre un piège
desc: Une créature aquatique gigantesque qui attire des proies imprudents à portée de dévoration avec sa tête pendante et polymorphe.

features.name: Doppel-Dangler
features.desc: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler’s head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. Mark a Stress to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler’s head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

features.name: Entice
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler’s head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

features.name: Gulp
features.desc: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes 3d6 physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

motives: Ramener les victimes au maître, submerger
desc: Une horde nocturne de démons soumis à un mal ancien.

features.name: Horde (2d6+2)
features.desc: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Swell Ranks
features.desc: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde’s ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

motives: Se nourrir d'émotions, localiser les innocents ou
desc: Un membre d'un ordre religieux d'une autre dimension, dévoué à explorer les limites de la souffrance et de l'extase mortelles.

features.name: Walk Between Worlds
features.desc: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

features.name: Pleasure and Pain
features.desc: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

motives: Respirer la foudre et parler le tonnerre, protéger
desc: Un énorm faucon qui niche dans les montagnes et déchaîne des tempêtes.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Bird of Prey
features.desc: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

features.name: Here Comes the Boom
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Crushing Grasp
features.desc: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). Nest Warden - Evolution: When the Roc’s eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:

features.name: Wrathful
features.desc: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

features.name: Electrifying Aura
features.desc: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

motives: Ambusher depuis le dessous, manger et partir, creuser et
desc: Un ver fouisseur gigantesque avec une carapace et des mâchoires grinçantes. Ce chasseur intelligent et opportuniste peut nager dans le sable aussi vite qu'un guépard court sur terre.

features.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Devour
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

features.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
features.desc: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

motives: Isoler, manœuvrer, protéger la forêt, désherber
desc: Un chevalier portant d'immenses et majestueux bois de cerf, vêtu d'une armure faite d'épines dangereuses.

features.name: From Above
features.desc: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 3d12+3 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Blade of the Forest
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to 3d4 + the target’s Major threshold.

features.name: Thorny Armor
features.desc: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d10+5 physical damage to the attacker.

motives: Exploser violemment, attendre, observer
desc: Un goliath ancien, sage et capricieux, dont les cheveux sont faits de brume et sur la peau de laquelle crépitent des éclairs.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Ball Lightning
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Titan conjure 1d4 spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes 4d6 magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

features.name: Storm Bringer
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Thunderclap
features.desc: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

motives: Tenir le mal à distance, protéger le sacré, percevoir
desc: Une avatar céleste du bien, prenant la forme d'un cheval d'une beauté surnaturelle, avec une longue corne spiralée émergeant de son front.

features.name: Celestial Lance
features.desc: The Unicorn’s standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

features.name: Healing Touch
features.desc: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. Mark any number of Stress to clear an equal number of the ally’s HP.

features.name: Protective Aura
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in eff ect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This eff ect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

features.name: Teleport
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

motives: Créer des serviteurs, charmer, commander, voler, intimider
desc: Un mort-vivant captivant vêtu de faste aristocratique.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Look into My Eyes
features.desc: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain 1d4 Fear.

features.name: Feed on Followers
features.desc: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: The Hunt Is On
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Lifesuck
features.desc: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a d8. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.

motives: Corrompre, détruire, submerger de puissance maléfique
desc: Un cruel seigneur vampire d'une époque perdue, maudit d'immortalité.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Midnight Heart
features.desc: Long-Term Countdown (6). The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it’s destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Unleash Hellfire
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure 1d4 bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals 3d6 magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

features.name: Resurgence
features.desc: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can spend a Fear to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Melt into Shadow
features.desc: When a PC would deal damage to the Vampire Lord, you can spend a Fear to roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, negate the damage, then teleport the Vampire Lord to a point within Far range. Hellwing - Evolution: When the Vampire Lord marks half their HP, they transform into the Hellwing: a towering, demonic bat creature. They gain the “On Crimson Wings” and “Bloodbath” features and replace their standard attack with the following standard attack: Claws: Close | 3d12+6 phy

features.name: On Crimson Wings
features.desc: While flying, the Hellwing gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodbath
features.desc: When the Hellwing takes Major or greater damage, the ground within Very Close range is covered with blood, dealing 3d10 magic damage to all other creatures in the area. When the Hellwing takes the spotlight on subsequent GM turns, all other creatures in that area take 3d6 magic damage.

motives: Enlever, piéger, protéger, rouer de coups
desc: Un constructeur cubique, couvert de poussière, avec de épaisses portes métalliques oscillantes sur son torse.

features.name: Blocking Shield
features.desc: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

features.name: Lock Up
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is Restrained within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While Restrained, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

motives: S'agripper à la proie, sucer le sang, déchirer en deux
desc: Un démon vampirique dont le torse se détache au coucher du soleil pour voler à travers les villages voisins à la recherche de victimes. Il a un torse ailé avec des entrails pendantes.

features.name: Join or Die
features.desc: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn’t reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

features.name: Entangling Entrails
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

features.name: Lifesuck
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

motives: Entraver les membres, lâcher d'une grande hauteur, soulever
desc: Les échos de promesses brisées et de rêves inaccomplis, se manifestant comme un voile translucide et déchiré de velours noir flottant, d'une forme vaguement humanoïde.

features.name: Greater Specter
features.desc: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Spooky
features.desc: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Nightmare Shroud
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, Shrouding the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While Shrouded, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the Shrouded target.

motives: Avalanche, défendre le repaire, voler, geler, défendre ce qui
desc: Un dragon bleu glacier avec quatre puissants membres et des ailes teintées de gel.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Rend and Crush
features.desc: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn’t mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: No Hope
features.desc: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Blizzard Breath
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to release an icy whorl in front of the Dragon within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d6+5 magic damage and are Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Avalanche
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. All targets within this area must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming Vulnerable until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Frozen Scales
features.desc: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become Chilled until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are Chilled, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives: Faire le lourd travail, sauter menaçamment, se déplacer
desc: Une bête de crapaud lourdement bâtie, née dans une tourbière, avec des sangsues en forme de têtards visiblement se tortillant sous sa peau translucide.

features.name: Toxic Skin
features.desc: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

features.name: Bear Hug
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is Grappled until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

features.name: Crunch!
features.desc: Spend a Fear to deal 4d12 direct physical damage to a creature Grappled by the Abomination.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

features.name: Burrowing Leechpoles
features.desc: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in 2d4 leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

motives: Grimper, se nourrir, éclore, engourdir, se déplacer rapidement
desc: Un parasite en forme de pieuvre qui s'accroche au crâne de sa proie, baignant le cerveau de la victime de neurotoxines extradimensionnelles.

features.name: Minion (12)
features.desc: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Comatize
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC’s brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. If a PC marks their last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a death move. If the PC dies, you can spend a Fear to resurrect them as a Cephilith Novitiate.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Hatchlings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives: Appeler et consommer des suiveurs, corrompre la réalité,
desc: Une entité transdimensionnelle sous la forme d'un humanoïde impossible à décrire, ailé et d'une taille gigantesque, avec une tête en forme de pieuvre et des rangées d'yeux lumineux.

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Merely a Projection
features.desc: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating their true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Psychic Scream
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. Each PC within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (22). Targets who fail take 4d12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Summon Worshippers
features.desc: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight. “It’s Here…” - Evolution: When the Titan has marked half their HP, they manifest in their full form, clearing all HP and losing the “Merely a Projection” feature. While the Titan is in this form, a creature who marks HP from the Titan’s standard attack must mark an additional HP.

motives: Consommer, remodeler le terrain, écraser
desc: Un crocogigante dont le corps est recouvert d'un patchwork d'écailles de poisson, de peau de crapaud et de dizaines de baves affamées.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Many Mouths
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Cipactli succeeds against must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Frenzied Feeding
features.desc: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Close range to succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 4d6 direct physical damage. The Cipactli clears a HP for each creature who took Severe damage from this attack.

features.name: Quaking Footfalls
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until they take damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Lifeblooded
features.desc: When the Cipactli takes Severe damage, its blood splashes to the ground and instantly erupts into a jungle. All creatures within Close range are temporarily Restrained.

features.name: Verdant Explosion
features.desc: When the Cipactli marks its last HP, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

motives: Détruire la bonté, semer le chaos, détrôner les rivaux
desc: Le souverain d'un cercle profond dans les Cercles Inférieurs, une bête hybride massive avec une queue de serpent, des pattes arrière de lézard, des bras-griffes de crabe et une tête de loup à deux visages.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Chaos Lash
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within Close range and force each target to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Gaze into the Abyss
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within Far range. The target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain one of the following conditions (roll a d6 and use the corresponding result): 1–2: Mesmerized. The target immediately moves into Melee range of Berzug and is Vulnerable and Restrained until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll. 3–4: Confused. The target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll until they clear the condition with a successful Knowledge Roll. 5–6: Enthralled. Until the PC makes a successful Presence Roll to clear the condition, you can spotlight them during a GM turn as if they were an adversary. When you do so, choose a target within Close range of the Enthralled PC. The Enthralled PC moves into Melee range of the target and makes a weapon attack against them using a d20 instead of Duality Dice.

features.name: Crushing Strike
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from Berzug’s standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force them to mark a number of Stress equal to the number of HP they marked. You gain a Fear.

features.name: Horrifying
features.desc: When a PC fails an attack against Berzug, you gain a Fear.

motives: Écraser, dominer, obtenir du soulagement, punir
desc: Une âme maudite liée à la volonté des Déchus.

features.name: Minion (12)
features.desc: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Aura of Doom
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives: Acquérir, démoraliser, dominer, tourmenter
desc: Un puissant mage lié par les pactes qu'il a conclus de son vivant.

features.name: Conflagration
features.desc: Spend a Fear to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take 2d10+6 direct magic damage.

features.name: Nightmare Tableau
features.desc: Mark a Stress to trap a target within Far range in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Slippery
features.desc: When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to Far range.

features.name: Shackles of Guilt
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become Vulnerable and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope. FALLEN WARLORD:

motives: Envoyer une mort sans pitié, punir les insolents,
desc: Celui que seuls les plus redoutés ont une chance de redouter.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Faltering Armor
features.desc: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by 1d10.

features.name: Shattering Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

features.name: Endless Legions
features.desc: Spend a Fear to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

features.name: Circle of Defilement
features.desc: Countdown (1d8). When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Doombringer
features.desc: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

motives: Submerger, servir, se jeter en masse
desc: Une armée innombrable de fantômes réveillés de leur sommeil sans rêve pour accomplir leur serment ancien.

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.desc: When the Legion has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6+5 magic damage instead.

features.name: Necroplasmic
features.desc: The Legion is immune to physical damage and takes double magic damage.

features.name: Final Act
features.desc: When the Legion is defeated, it makes a standard attack against all targets within Close range before being dispelled.

motives: Chasser, chercher une ouverture, fondre
desc: Une créature léonine de grande taille qui possède la tête, les serres et les ailes d'un aigle.

features.name: Treasure Hoarder
features.desc: When a PC would mark any number of HP from the Griffin’s attack, the PC can choose instead to give the Griffin an equal number of bags of gold.

features.name: Swooping Slash
features.desc: Move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target along the way.

motives: Concentrez le feu, obéissez, repositionnez-vous, salve
desc: Soldats esprituels avec des arcs sanctifiés.

features.name: Punish the Guilty
features.desc: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked Guilty by a High Seraph.

features.name: Divine Volley
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

motives: Apportez le jugement, les abattez, bougez rapidement,
desc: Un corps momifié chevauchant un cheval squelettique. Leurs yeux sont cousus et leur corps est enveloppé d'un linceul de poussière et de cendres.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.desc: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Fear the Reaper
features.desc: When a creature is defeated within Far range of the Harbinger, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Decapitate
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger make an attack roll against a PC within Melee range. On a success, roll a d6. On a result of 6, the target marks all HP and must make a death move.

features.name: Wake the Fallen
features.desc: Spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to have the Harbinger resurrect a defeated ally within Far range. The resurrected ally clears a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked. Immediately spotlight the ally.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
features.nameEn: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
features.desc: When the Harbinger would mark HP, you can mark a Stress to have an ally within Far range mark the HP instead.

motives: Drainer appauvrir, affaiblir, flétrir
desc: Une dépouille desséchée montée sur un cheval blanchâtre. Ils sont couverts de bouches et entourés de mouches qui s'agitent.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.desc: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Hunger Pangs
features.desc: Countdown (Decreasing 6). When the Harbinger appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Harbinger is spotlighted. When it triggers, all PCs within Far range mark a Stress and become Ravenous. While Ravenous, a PC can’t spend Hope until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Drain Essence
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs. Each target takes 4d6 magic damage.

features.name: Too Many Mouths
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a PC within Melee range. On a success, the Harbinger grabs the target and bites them, dealing 4d6 physical damage and Restraining the target until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Withering Touch
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger caress the face of a Restrained PC within Melee range. The target marks 2 Stress and either loses a Hope or marks 1d4 HP.

motives: Détruisez totalement, combattez honorablement, savourez le combat,
desc: Un guerrier revêtu d'une armure noire et d'un heaume cornu, tenant une bannière sanglante.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.desc: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Iron Dice
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Harbinger attempt a risky all-out attack. Make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, the target marks an additional HP. On a failure, the Harbinger becomes Vulnerable until they take or deal damage.

features.name: Supreme Commander
features.desc: Once per scene, spend a Fear to summon 1d6 Hallowed Soldiers within Close range and immediately spotlight one of them.

features.name: Battering Ram
features.desc: When a PC fails an action roll within Close range, you can spend a Fear to move into Melee range with the PC and make a standard attack with advantage against them. On a success, the PC takes standard damage and is Vulnerable until they are spotlighted.

motives: Faire respecter le dogme, volez, prononcez le jugement, frapper
desc: Un champion divin, à la tête d'une hôte sacrée de guerriers qui font respecter la volonté de leur dieu.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.desc: While the Seraph is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Judgment
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a target Guilty in the eyes of the Seraph’s god until the Seraph is defeated. While Guilty, the target doesn’t gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a Guilty target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

features.name: God Rays
features.desc: Mark a Stress to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked Guilty. Targets who fail take 4d6+12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: We Are One
features.desc: Once per scene, spend a Fear to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

motives: Démolir, dévorer, miner
desc: Une parodie chaotique de la vie, en perpétuel changement.

features.name: Chaotic Form
features.desc: When the Abomination attacks, roll 2d4 and use the result as their attack modifier.

features.name: Disorienting Presence
features.desc: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Reality Quake
features.desc: Spend a Fear to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become Unstuck from reality until the end of the scene. When an Unstuck target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

features.name: Unreal Form
features.desc: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by 1d20. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

motives: Confondre, distraire, submerger
desc: Une masse informe et changeante, semblable être faite de lumière chromatique.

features.name: Will-Shattering Touch
features.desc: When a PC takes damage from the Corrupter, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

motives: Détruire, dégoûter, désorienter, intimider
desc: Une forme vaguement humanoïde dépouillée de sa mémoire et de son identité.

features.name: Minion (13)
features.desc: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives: Fendre la terre, fondre, protéger le trésor
desc: Un dragon ailé géant dont les écailles scintillantes et incrustées de gemmes révèlent des flammes visibles. Sa chaleur corporelle fait fondre la pierre.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Fearsome
features.desc: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Melting Breath
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d12+10 magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Volcanic Fissure
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take 4d8+5 magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes 4d8+5 magic damage.

features.name: Hot-Blooded
features.desc: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon’s blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they mark 1d4 HP.

motives: Maudire la lumière, glisser entre les fissures, diviser
desc: Une ombre vivante bidimensionnelle liée aux plans et surfaces planes.

features.name: Minion (12)
features.desc: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shadow Grapple
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Severed Shadows within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

motives: Réparer la chronologie, rechercher temporel
desc: Un être mécanique géant provenant d'une dimension hors du temps, construit par les Gardiens du Temps pour préserver le Saint Continuum.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Time Looper
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Enforcer first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all HP, Stress, and conditions. Reroll the countdown when the Enforcer takes Severe damage.

features.name: Move Between Moments
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within Very Far range, then spotlight them again.

features.name: Instant Rewind
features.desc: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the die.

features.name: Invert Polarity
features.desc: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This eff ect can’t be used to alter a critical success. VOLCANIC DRAGON:

motives: Défendre le repaire, plonger-bomber, voler, chasser, intimider
desc: Une créature ailée massive aux écailles d'obsidienne et des griffes incroyablement tranchantes.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Flying
features.desc: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Obsidian Scales
features.desc: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Avalanche Tail
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 4d6+4 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range and Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.

features.name: Dive-Bomb
features.desc: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 2d10+6 physical damage and must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

features.name: Erupting Rage (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them. VOLCANIC DRAGON:

motives: Étouffer, voler, intimider, tuer ou être tué
desc: Aucun ennemi n'a jamais eu l'insolence de blesser le dragon ainsi. Alors que la lave se solidifie, tout est réduit en cendre comme les passés adversaires du dragon.

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.desc: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cornered
features.desc: Mark a Stress instead of spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.

features.name: Injured Wings
features.desc: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes
features.desc: When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can’t lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

features.name: Desperate Rampage
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take 2d20+2 physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Ashen Cloud
features.desc: Spend a Fear to smash the ground and kick up ash within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

features.name: Apocalyptic Thrashing
features.desc: Countdown (1d12). Spend a Fear to activate. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+10 physical damage and are Restrained by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

motives: Consommer, déchirer, essaimer
desc: Une couvée de dragons nouvellement éclos. Comme nouveau-nés, ils sont furieux, affamés et stupides.

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.desc: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Ravenous
features.desc: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can spend a Fear to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

motives: Laisser une traînée de destruction, raser des bâtiments,
desc: Un reptile bipède de la taille d'un château.

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.desc: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Collateral Damage
features.desc: Xero’s movement can’t be hindered, impeded, or aff ected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero’s path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

features.name: Gigaton Stomp
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes 4d12 physical damage and is Restrained until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d12 physical damage as they land.

features.name: Power Slide
features.desc: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

features.name: Radioactive Breath
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can spend this token and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d12+12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can’t use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

features.name: Regeneration
features.desc: Up to three times per scene, spend any number of Fear to clear an equal number of HP.

motives: Consommer le cerveau, déchirer la chair, entourer
desc: Une grande meute de morts-vivants, encore puissants malgré leur chair qui pourrit.

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.desc: When the Legion has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Unyielding
features.desc: The Legion has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Legion takes Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker. adversaries, such as the physical space, background NPCs, and DESCRIPTION An evocative one-line summary of the environment.
